sloka: दुःखेन च सुसन्तप्तः स्मृत्वा तद्घोरदर्शनम् ।अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ।। ७.१०५.१७ ॥
transliteration: duḥkhena ca susantaptaḥ smṛtvā tadghoradarśanam ।avāṅmukho dīnamanā vyāhartuṁ na śaśāka ha ।। 7.105.17 ॥

translations.english: Deeply distressed by sorrow and remembering that terrible sight, he became downcast and dejected, unable to utter a word.
